mapper.select: SELECT r.review_id, r.users_id, r.store_id, r.userspayment_id, r.reviewcomment_id, r.review_star, r.review_image, r.review_date, r.review_status, r.review_title, r.review_content, r.review_response, u.users_nickname AS userNickname, u.users_profile AS userProfile FROM review r JOIN users u ON r.users_id = u.users_id WHERE r.review_status = 'Y' ORDER BY r.review_id DESC
SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.review_star), 1) FROM review r JOIN users u ON r.users_id = u.users_id WHERE r.review_status = 'Y' AND u.users_status = 'active'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review r JOIN users u ON r.users_id = u.users_id WHERE r.review_status = 'Y' AND u.users_status = 'active'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_star = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as star5, SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_star = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as star4, SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_star = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as star3, SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_star = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as star2, SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_star = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as star1 FROM review r JOIN users u ON r.users_id = u.users_id WHERE r.review_status = 'Y' AND u.users_status = 'active'

SELECT r.review_id, r.users_id, r.store_id, r.userspayment_id, r.reviewcomment_id, r.review_star, r.review_image, r.review_date, r.review_status, r.review_title, r.review_content, r.review_response, u.users_nickname, u.users_profile FROM review r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.users_id = u.users_id WHERE r.review_id = #{reviewId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review ( users_id, store_id, userspayment_id, reviewcomment_id, review_star, review_image, review_date, review_status, review_title, review_content, review_response ) VALUES ( #{usersId}, #{storeId}, #{usersPaymentId}, #{reviewCommentId}, #{reviewStar}, #{reviewImage}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'Y', #{reviewTitle}, #{reviewContent}, #{reviewResponse} )
mapper.select: SELECT r.review_id, r.users_id, r.store_id, r.userspayment_id, r.reviewcomment_id, r.review_star, r.review_image, r.review_date, r.review_status, r.review_title, r.review_content, r.review_response FROM review r INNER JOIN store s ON r.store_id = s.store_id WHERE s.store_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{restaurantName}, '%') AND r.review_status = 'Y' ORDER BY r.review_id DESC

SELECT review_id, users_id, store_id, userspayment_id, reviewcomment_id, review_star, review_image, review_date, review_status, review_title, review_content, review_response FROM review WHERE review_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reviewTitle}, '%') AND review_status = 'Y' ORDER BY review_id DESC
